notes.title: v1.016 Now Live
notes.content:
Hello! I'm aware it's been a few weeks since the last update - bugs are now coming in so infrequently that daily updates no longer really make sense, so I'm saving them all up for larger patches.


- Linux version now has a 64-bit version available
- Fixed an issue where skipping Splash screens with a gamepad caused the 'Save warting' dialogue to be missed
- Fixed missing characters in the dyslexic-friendly font option
- Accessing the top bit of a boat is now way easier
- Fixed an issue where starting a conversation the instant a lift started to move caused Camera Issues
- Fixed some potentially-sticky ice
- Fixed some extraordinarily minor typos

As always, if you find a bug please let me know at dan@sizefivegames.com, rather than leaving messages in places I might not see them.

If you've enjoyed Lair of the Clockwrok God but haven't yet REVIEWED it on Steam, please please do take a second to do that right now. It really helps me out.

Hope you're staying home and safe during these weird times.

Best,

Dan

notes.content:
- Added Platforming Assist slider
- Minor bug fixes

[b]This update adds a SUPER NEAT Platforming Assist slider,[/b] which tweaks a few platforming settings to suit your needs, including:

- Dan's 'wallgrab' time, giving you more time to react
- Dan's 'wallslide' speed
- Slows down certain tile types (blinking tiles, collapsible tiles, lasers etc)
- Removes some hazards entirely

If you're finding the platforming too much of a challenge, or you're just not particularly interested in 'that side' of the game, check it out.

This feature is in BETA, so may break things. If it does, or if there's something you want added to the slider, let me know: dan@sizefivegames.com

notes.title: v1.012 Now Live!
notes.content:
[b]It's been a couple of days wince the last update.[/b] I've been saving them up for one BIG HUGE FIX:

- Fixed a typo, that's the level we're down to now.
- Fixed a dialogue option that should have been switched off, but wasn't
- Fixed an issue where showing Dan a bra would cause Ben to never stop looking
- Fixed an issue where killing Ben would make everything go black
- Fixed Ben being unable to teleport in Chapter 11, if running from a load
- Fixed Ben sliding along weirdly, using his nose to drag himself painfully across the floor if he dies
- Flipping a switch twice and then dying no longer gets you stuck in an impossible situation
- De-subtled a colour-based puzzle
- Amalgamated some controls	

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] based on player feedback PUSH and CYCLE HOTSPOT now share a key (default X on a gamepad)
If you're in the middle of your game, this change may prove confusing! The old button still works, so hopefully not. Email me if this chance is bad!

[b]As always[/b] if anything has gone WRONG with this build, because I'm an idiot, you can rollback to a previous version by opting into the Beta branch called "rollback".

[b]PLEASE LEAVE A STEAM REVIEW[/b] if you played the game. Steam reviews feed an algorithm, the algorithm gets me views, and views get me sales, which I need. Thank you!

notes.title: v1.01 NOW LIVE
notes.content:
HELLO! Thanks everyone buying an playing the game! If you're enjoying it, please remember to shout about it online! Facebook, Reddit, TikTok, whevever you hang out. ALSO: please take a second to leave a Steam review!

Here's what's happened in v1.01:

[b]NOT FIXED:[/b]
The "Dan jumping on Ben's head" bug persists. Sure I'll nail it soon :)

[b]FIXED:[/b]
- Ben now dies properly if you squish him into the floor with a toilet
- Dan is no longer able to drive a tractor when on fire
- Added a cat.
- Fixed an autosave bug that would cause an invisible old lady to appear
- Fixed an issue where a couple of characters thought they were called Ben
- It should no longer be possible to get anyone stuck in a big pile of ice.
- Ben should no longer magically stop being playable in the Shed? WTF?
- Tweaked a line of dialogue that could be mis-read as offensive
- 'Skip Dialogue' key is now user-assignable
- Tweaked some achievement names so they're not spoilers. Hid some others.
- Minor tweaks and fixes for secret things you don't even know about yet.

Thanks all! Any bugs please report them to dan@sizefivegames.com, so they won't get lost amid Discord, Twitter, DMs, etc etc!

Dan
